rule:
(the rule of the D / D+KD-band figure, fixed here before rendering):
  1. Run value: slice DSC is the mean over RV, MYO and LV (a class absent from prediction and
     reference is left out); slices are averaged within patients, then patients are averaged.
  2. Seed: among seeds 1-3, the seed whose paired run-level DSC difference, BDS-Lite minus D,
     is closest to the median of the three differences.
  3. Slices: among slices whose reference contains RV, MYO and LV, the slices nearest the 90th,
     50th and 10th percentiles of the paired slice-level DSC difference (BDS-Lite minus D) of
     that seed, with at most one slice per patient.
  4. Columns: image, GT, U, D, BDS-Lite, change against D (BDS-Lite versus D).
